title: Rized's Best Optimization Pack
description: The best optimization mods I've used. Highly configurable.
body:
A collection of the best optimization mods I've used. It's a compilation of all the mods from various modpacks.

DISTANT HORIZONS IS OPTIONAL AND CONFIGURABLE. DISABLE IT IF IT DOESN'T WORK FOR YOU.

DUE TO COPYRIGHT ISSUES YOU NEED TO DOWNLOAD THIS TWO MODS BY SOURSELF AND INSTALL IN YOUR MOD FOLDER
